cot.step: First, we need to locate all rows in the table under the “HARDWARE” category.
Extract the “QTY ON HAND” values for all items in this category.
Calculate the average (mean) of these values by summing them and dividing by the total number of items.
Calculate the standard deviation by measuring the square root of the variance (the average of the squared differences from the mean).
